thesis: The strongest short thesis is that Vertiv is being valued on peak AI-infrastructure growth while H1 cash conversion is flattered by working capital, customers retain substantial design/procurement power, capacity is expanding aggressively, and the signed UIG deal deploys up to $2.6B near a cyclical high. A 50%-plus drawdown is plausible if organic growth and margins normalize together. However, strong backlog, low dilution, effective controls and internal cash generation prevent any Hard Veto from being confirmed.

evidence.claim: The cutoff price is about 1.04x locked Base value, leaving limited valuation margin if Base growth/margins miss.
H1 2026 OCF of $1.867B included a $678.8M working-capital source while inventory increased sharply.
The UIG agreement calls for approximately $1.45B upfront cash plus up to $1.15B contingent cash consideration.
Large cloud and hyperscale customers have significant purchasing power, while global industrial competitors can respond with power and cooling alternatives.
Backlog was $15.0B at 2025 year-end, which supports demand but also creates delivery, pricing and execution exposure if schedules or input economics shift.

counterevidence: Operating profit has grown far faster than sales since 2023, demonstrating real operating leverage.
June cash plus short-term investments slightly exceeded long-term debt and H1 OCF was strong.
Diluted share growth has been modest while FCF/share increased.
Power density, liquid cooling and grid constraints are structural demand drivers beyond ordinary replacement cycles.
unknowns: Top-customer concentration and cancellation rights within backlog.
UIG valuation multiple and integration returns.
How much current pricing power survives when industry capacity catches up.
falsifiers: Organic growth remains above 15% with stable/improving margins after backlog growth normalizes.
Normalized FCF/share continues compounding after working-capital reversal and UIG closes.
Service/liquid-cooling content expands across customers without material pricing pressure.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: FY2025 internal controls were effective and no material restatement, auditor dispute or integrity event is identified.
Operating cash flow comfortably funds ordinary operations and capex; external financing is not structurally required for survival.
Firm backlog, mission-critical uptime demand and expanding operating margins directly contradict absence of customer value.
Operating profit and FCF/share rose substantially from 2023-2025, contradicting a structural collapse below the cost of capital.
Backlog, service scale, margins and portfolio breadth are expanding rather than persistently shrinking.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is materially below the locked Bull DCF value; the literal Bull+ veto condition is not met.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Vertiv spans multiple power, thermal, rack and service offerings across three major regions; concentration risk exists but no single disclosed dependency is shown to be fatal.

key_kpis.name: normalized FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Base path maintained after WC normalization

key_kpis.name: orders/backlog
key_kpis.threshold: no sustained contraction ahead of sales

key_kpis.name: UIG ROIC/net leverage
key_kpis.threshold: returns above cost of capital with leverage controlled
